items.headline: DJ Lagway throws 2 TD passes, runs for a score as Baylor surges to 42-31 win over Iowa State
items.description: — DJ Lagway threw for 229 yards with two touchdowns and ran for a career-high 119 yards and another score as Baylor surged past Iowa State 42-31 on Saturday in the first home game for the Bears since the firing of coach Dave Aranda.
